children.name: The Guild is quintessential San Diego, a storied landmark reimagined as a sophisticated playground for locals and visitors alike. Grand and casual, elegant and unexpected, The Guild is an urban resort and destination unlike anything else in the city.

children.name: Behind this mannered Italian Renaissance facade is a century of glamorous mischief. Today, it’s an icon with open arms, a high-spirited destination that welcomes you to the heart of contemporary San Diego.
